title: Persuasion by Parts
abstract: arXiv:2611.02845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classical Bayesian persuasion assumes that an information designer can condition signals on the entire state. We propose persuasion by parts. In this model, the receiver's payoff from acting is $X = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$ for independent coordinates $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ observed by separate sources. The designer commits in advance to a product experiment, in which each source $i$ can condition its signal only on $X_i$. Given the signals, the receiver computes her posterior mean $y$ of $X$ and acts with probability $g(y)$, where $g\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$ is a nondecreasing function. The designer aims to maximize the probability of action.   Let $V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g)$ and $V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)$ be the supremum probabilities of action under persuasion by parts and under joint persuasion, respectively. When the designer knows $g$, we show $$   V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g) \;\ge\; c\,V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)^2 \qquad\text{for every nondecreasing } g\colo

translated_abstract: 经典的贝叶斯说服假设信息设计者可以基于整个状态来设定信号。我们提出了“分部说服”。在该模型中，接受者采取行动的收益为 $X = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$，其中相互独立的分量 $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ 分别由各自的信源观测。设计者预先承诺采用一个乘积实验，其中每个信源 $i$ 只能依据 $X_i$ 来设定其信号。在观察到信号后，接受者计算 $X$ 的后验均值 $y$，并以概率 $g(y)$ 采取行动，其中 $g\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$ 是一个非递减函数。设计者的目标是最大化行动发生的概率。设 $V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g)$ 与 $V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)$ 分别表示分部说服与联合说服下行动概率的上确界。当设计者知道 $g$ 时，我们证明对于任意非递减的 $g$，均有 $V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g) \ge c\,V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)^2$……
tldr: 本文提出“分部说服”模型，即信息设计者被限制在各信源只能基于独立状态分量设定信号的乘积实验中，并证明了即使在这种受限条件下，分部说服所实现的行动概率仍可达到联合说服最优值的平方量级（相差常数倍）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "persuasion by parts" model, in which the information designer is restricted to product experiments where each source conditions its signal only on an independent state coordinate, and proves that even under this restriction the induced action probability is at least a constant times the square of the optimal joint-persuasion value.
